# owner: platform
"""Weekly timesheet rows, one line of text per worker."""

from typing import List
from hourglass.schedule import worker_minutes
from hourglass.models import Shift
from collections import Counter

# ---
def timesheet_lines(shifts: List[Shift]) -> List[str]:
    """One line per worker, busiest first."""
    if not shifts:
        raise ValueError("no shifts for a timesheet")
    if any(not shift.worker.strip() for shift in shifts):
        raise ValueError("a shift has a blank worker name")
    minutes = worker_minutes(shifts)
    counts = Counter(shift.worker for shift in shifts)
    busiest = sorted(
        minutes,
        key=lambda name: (-minutes[name], name)
    )
    lines = []
    for name in busiest:
        count = counts[name]
        noun = "shift" if count == 1 else "shifts"
        hours = minutes[name] / 60
        text = f"{name}: {count} {noun}, {hours:.1f} hours"
        lines.append(text)
    return lines
